Subject: Sponsor handover & freight window — Redwood Zone C

Hi Vivek —

Quick logistics note as we lock the venue handover for Redwood in Zone C. Attached is the freight manifest and preferred label format. Key items: 

- Freight window: Tue 9/7, 08:00–12:00 (Dock D4). Please confirm trailer ETA and onsite contact for the driver.
- Crate labeling: use "REDWOOD_ZONEC_#" prefix per attached template.
- Install window: Tue 9/7 evening is available for final set (20:00–23:00) if you request late-night access.
- Electrical pad: single 20A; AV power run should be ordered if you need more than one outlet.

Ask: can you confirm who will be on-site for handover and whether you need NorthStar crew for lift-assist during crate unload? If you need us to reserve extra crew, we can add two laborers for $180/hr (estimate attached).

Erin
Erin Park
Event Operations Manager | NorthStar Events

- On-site lead: Vivek Kulkarni (cell: +1-415-555-0198).
- Install crew: we will bring two full-time technical leads (install), plus a third floater. We may request 1x NorthStar lift-assist for the heaviest crate (crate #7).
- Collateral manifest: press kits (150), demo iPads (6), swag (500 tees), rollcases (4).
- Signage plan: we want permission to install a 10ft freestanding backwall + two hanging ceiling banners over Zone C (permit request attached).

Attached: Redwood install plan draft (redwood_install_plan_v2.pdf) with tentative run-of-show. Can you: 
1) Confirm late-night install access for Tue 9/7 20:00–23:00?
2) Confirm if hanging banners need pre-approval from show ops and any additional fees?

If late-night install is not available, we will shift to Wed 9/8 first window (06:00–09:00) and will need extra labor.

Thanks — Vivek

- Press-kit printing: vendor needs final PDF by 8/24 to hit pre-event delivery.

1) Approve procurement for 2x rollcases (OK to use event budget) — reply "APPROVE_ROLLCASE"
2) Confirm we sign the hanging banner permit if fee <= $350 — reply "APPROVE_PERMIT" or "ESCALATE_PERMIT"

Logan — can you confirm how many extra power drops we have in our booth order? If we need more than one 20A we'll have to add on-site patching.
